description: This file defines API routes for bug management in a bug tracking system, including functions for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting bugs via a FastAPI router.

methods.name: list_bugs(project_id: Optional[UUID] = None, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list bugs, optionally filtered by project_id.

methods.name: create_bug(payload: BugCreate, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new bug report, assigns it to a user if specified, and logs the creation.

methods.name: get_bug(bug_id: UUID, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific bug by its ID.

methods.name: update_bug(bug_id: UUID, payload: BugUpdate, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update bug details; restricted to the assignee, managers, or admins; logs updates and notifies new assignee.

methods.name: delete_bug(bug_id: UUID, user: UserProfile = Depends(require_role("manager")))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a bug, restricted to managers or admins, with audit logging.

ctags.name: list_bugs
ctags.pattern: /^def list_bugs(project_id: Optional[UUID] = None, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user)):$/

ctags.name: update_bug
ctags.pattern: /^def update_bug(bug_id: UUID, payload: BugUpdate, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user)):$/
ctags.signature: (bug_id: UUID, payload: BugUpdate, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
